scope: Direct GoalSelector/TargetSelector registrations plus resolved inheritance/imperative behavior for all non-boss hostile/allied/passive entity classes under entity/monster and entity/passive.
caveats: Direct registrations were machine-cataloged and then inheritance/imperative false negatives were manually reviewed.
Vanilla parent internals are referenced semantically rather than copied into this repository.
Bosses remain cataloged separately in BOSS-AI-MATRIX.json.
